question: Wind energy percentage  in 2016 is lower than that in 2017, yes or no?
detailed_evidences:

- In 2016, the proportion of renewable energy was higher at 54.1%, compared to 39% in 2017 despite a 5.5% lower electricity demand in 2017.
- Wind energy contributed 21.9% in 2016, slightly lower than 22.7% in 2017.
- Solar PV's generation was 3.3% in 2016, decreased to 2.9% in 2017.
- Solar thermal energy saw a decrease from 1.9% in 2016 to 1.4% in 2017.

question: Strain measurements using neutron diffraction were conducted by positioning the engine blocks in specific orientations to measure strain components in hoop, radial, and axial directions, yes or no?
detailed_evidences: Strain measurements using neutron diffraction were conducted by positioning the engine blocks in specific orientations to measure strain components in hoop, radial, and axial directions. For hoop strain, the block was aligned to form a scattering vector tangential to the cylinder bore. The radial strain component was measured by repositioning the block to form a scattering vector in the radial direction. Finally, axial strain was measured by positioning the block so that the scattering vector was parallel to the cylinder axis (<evidence_sources>[Pure-text, Figure]</evidence_sources> <box>(0.12, 0.54, 0.32, 0.56)</box>, <box>(0.13, 0.09, 0.87, 0.33)</box>, <evidence_sources>[Pure-text]</evidence_sources> <box>(0.12, 0.44, 0.88, 0.57)</box>, <evidence_pages>[67, 68, 70]</evidence_pages>). Proper positioning was crucial for accurate measurement within the cylinder bridge region.

question:
What is the cumulative actual total acreage of wetlands created under the Wolf River OV projects?
(A). 859 acres
(B). 12 acres
(C). 0 acres
(D). 400 acres
Choose the letter name in front of the right option from A, B, C, D.
detailed_evidences:
The cumulative actual total acreage of wetlands created under the Wolf River OV project is 859 acres, with an expected total of 12 acres, per page 75 ("Cumulative Actual Total/Expected Total 859/12": <box>(0.65, 0.1, 0.88, 0.14)</box>, page 75).

For the Big Creek OV project, tree mitigation is planned over 400 acres of land, but no actual new acreage of wetlands created specifically is mentioned, supported by the zero value under "This Report Period Total" of successfully reforested acreage (page 83: <box>(0.43, 0.1, 0.47, 0.11)</box>, page 83).

Therefore, combining these totals, the actual acreage summed is 859 acres for wetlands newly created or preserved.

question:
What is the most common age groups for heat deaths among African American, Hispanic and American Indian populations, respectively?
(A). 35-49, 50-64, 50-64
(B). 50-64, 35-49, 50-64
(C). 50-64, 35-49, 35-49
(D). 50-64, 35-49, 20-34
Choose the letter name in front of the right option from A, B, C, D.
detailed_evidences: Among African Americans, the most common age group for heat deaths was 50-64, as indicated on page 68 (<box>(0.12, 0.1, 0.58, 0.15)</box>, <evidence_sources>[Title]</evidence_sources>). Among Hispanics, this age group was 35-49, as noted on page 70 (<box>(0.13, 0.21, 0.87, 0.9)</box>, <evidence_sources>[Figure]</evidence_sources>). For American Indians, the most common age group was 50-64, as reported on page 72 (<box>(0.12, 0.1, 0.57, 0.15)</box>, <evidence_sources>[Title]</evidence_sources>). Therefore, the respective common age groups are [50-64, 35-49, 50-64].
